correctness.rationale: For U(t)=t(t²+1)(2t²+1)(t²+2)(t²−1)(t⁴+t²+1) nonzero, the quartic identity Q_t(x)=(4t²x²+1)²+16(t²+1)(t−1)²x² and A²=t²+(t²+1)B² yield quartic roots i(εA+δB√(t²+1))/(2t²). The two other branch roots are ±√(-t)/2. Difference of quartic roots recovers i and i√(t²+1), and hence s; quadratic roots recover √t. The resultant 256(t−1)^4A^4 excludes collisions. Distinct root actions follow directly by applying signs under any Galois automorphism. In Fq, each sign is χ(-1),χ(t²+1),χ(t); q ≡ 3 mod 4 has opposite quadratic-pair fixedness. External Jacobian isomorphism is correctly cited as Abdellatif Theorem 2, not independently proved. Confirmed polynomial identities/resultant with fresh SymPy and direct character-root counts for all admissible t in prime fields 5..31. Full field proof, not finite enumeration, proves universal part.
